competitor_context.headline: Hanwha Ocean wins 3 VLGC order worth 477.8bn won, but only ~8.6% FX hedge ratio
competitor_context.implication_for_target: Hanwha Ocean's low hedge ratio means its earnings are far more exposed to further won moves; Samsung Heavy's near-full hedge gives it a steadier earnings profile by comparison in the current won-strength phase.

competitor_context.headline: HD Hyundai Heavy Industries partial strike begins Sept 2 after wage talks collapse
competitor_context.implication_for_target: Elevated labor risk at a rival yard, contrasted with no comparable strike headline at Samsung Heavy this cycle, is a mild relative positive for Samsung Heavy's delivery-reliability narrative with shipowners.
